newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Citibank drops plan to buy Konzumbank.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Citibank drops plan to buy Konzumbank.

text.p: Citibank Budapest Rt, the wholly-owned Hungarian banking unit of Citibank Overseas Investment Corp, said it had dropped its plan to buy Konzumbank Rt.
"Citibank's long-term strategy does not allow the purchase of Konzumbank," Citibank said in a statement.
Konzumbank is member of state-owned development bank Magyar Fejlesztesi Bank group.

"Citibank Budapest Rt recently reviewed the possibility of buying Konzumbank...and the preliminary review showed that Konzumbank's current activity and clientele do not fit into Citibank's long-term strategy," the statement said.
